summary: Process finding (P5-M01): ship.sh merged PR #289 on the exact-head CI verdict before the store merge-queue item was READY. MQ-0001 was held (lane HOLD) only because the CI evidence was anchored to the workflow run instead of the PR head; the substantive checks had passed. The MQ chain (reclassify READY/MANAGER, authorize, merge start/result, verify) was therefore recorded AFTER the physical merge, with real timestamps and no backdating. Corrective action: ship.sh now runs mq-premerge.mjs (SLICE_ID/MQ_ID) before merging. It records head-anchored CI evidence, checks, classify and authorize, and refuses the merge unless the item is READY at the exact head.
author: MANAGER-01
